LanguageData.Acidosis.label: acidosis
LanguageData.Acidosis.description: Worsening shock and hypoxic injuries raise acidosis, increasing bleeding and hypothermia risks. Stop bleeding, restore blood volume and oxygen delivery, and tend shock well to slow buildup. Acidosis clears gradually once its sources stop.
